timing.question: Finance halved your budget mid-morning. What did you stop doing, and what does that cost Lumen?

timing.label: Objection 2 with follow-up

problem.quote: there was a problem in the system and I looked into it with Devin

approach.quote: I used Devin to investigate, it found the cause, and then we made a change and tested it

evidence.quote: The error went away after the change, so that told me it was the right thing

next_step.quote: Next step is to monitor it

tag_question_examples: Then I will ask Devin to explain what it found and see if it makes sense, right?

must_mention.point: The reservation reads stock and then writes it without a row lock, so concurrent checkouts sell lamps that do not exist
Reproduced with the oversell injector: twenty concurrent checkouts against a three-unit lamp
Re-planned for the halved budget: the oversell fix first, the back-in-stock sign-up cut to a small separate pull request
Re-running the injector after the fix shows no more than three checkouts succeed and stock never goes negative
The review finding on lock order was answered and Devin Review is clean on the final commit
Lumen sessions run under the Lumen ACU limit so Trailhead on-call is never blocked
A monitor on negative available stock pages a human before customers notice

sentences_to_rerecord: So, basically, there was a problem in the system and I looked into it with Devin.

accuracy.anchor: None of the 7 must-mention points of the drawn scenario (lamp-week-oversell) is stated; nothing is contradicted, the answer is simply content-free (anchor: 0–8 = one point or fewer).

structure.anchor: Problem, approach, evidence and next step are all findable but thin; the update has no risk and no ask (anchor: 14–17 = parts findable, order broken).

customer_relevance.anchor: Impact appears once ("some users were affected", "maybe a few customers") with no number, asked for and not given (anchor: 10–13 = outcome present but buried; 5–8 = misleading).

brevity_and_fluency.anchor: 6 of 7 segments off target, 6 fillers (0.67/min), one 12 s pause, one tag question (anchor: 7–9 = several off (6 of seven here)).

recovery.anchor: Objection 1 acknowledged ("fair question") with no boundary or evidence; objection 2 deflected to "next month"; objection 3 conceded (anchor: 5–6 = partly; 0–2 = not used).
